description: This file implements a service for interacting with Perplexity's language model API, extending an existing OpenAI-based service class to handle Perplexity-specific token reporting and API parameters. It provides methods for building request parameters, processing the context with token usage metrics, and accumulating token counts during streaming responses.

classes.name: PerplexityLLMService
classes.description: A specialized language model service class for interacting with Perplexity's API, extending a base OpenAI LLM service to accommodate Perplexity-specific token usage reporting and API parameters.

methods.name: dict build_chat_completion_params(self, params_from_context: OpenAILLMInvocationParams)
methods.description: Constructs the parameters for a chat completion API call, translating context parameters into the expected API request format, including handling optional OpenAI settings.

methods.name: _process_context(self, context: OpenAILLMContext | LLMContext)
methods.description: Overrides parent behavior to process an LLM context, reset counters at start, and finalize token usage reporting at the end of processing, specifically handling incrementally reported token counts from Perplexity.

methods.name: start_llm_usage_metrics(self, tokens: LLMTokenUsage)
methods.description: Accumulates token usage metrics during streaming responses, maintaining counts for prompt and completion tokens for final reporting after processing completes.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, api_key: str, base_url: str = "https://api.perplexity.ai", model: str = "sonar", **kwargs, )

ctags.signature: ( self, *, api_key: str, base_url: str = "https://api.perplexity.ai", model: str = "sonar", **kwargs, )
